Content: The ten heavenly stems are yang and yin pairs of each element: Gap/Eul (Wood), Byeong/Jeong (Fire), Mu/Gi (Earth), Gyeong/Sin (Metal) and Im/Gye (Water). Stems are read as the 'heaven' or outward layer of a chart.
Source: How to Read Marital Harmony (Gunghap 3) - Korea Times
Label: Tradition - for reflection

Content: Some yang-yin stem pairs are said to 'combine', such as Gap Wood with Gi Earth. These pairs are read as natural affinity in a chart.
Source: How to Read Marital Harmony (Gunghap 3) - Korea Times
Label: Tradition - for reflection

Content: Yang stems are read as active and outward, yin stems as receptive and steady. The calendar alternates between them.
